title: Impact of calcium, zinc or aluminum dimethylphosphate coordination polymers on flame retardancy and rheological properties of poly(butylene succinate)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4432-4444
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06774J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mateusz Kullas, Maciej Dębowski, Paweł Groch, Anna Czajka-Warowna, Krystyna Czaja
PBS/20%MtDOP composites achieved V-2 rating in UL-94 test. CaDMP enhanced the LOI value from 23.6% for neat PBS to 27.3% for PBS/20%CaDMP. ZnDMP in amount of 20 wt% reduced pHRR and THE by 57 and 24%, respectively.
